text:
[Council File 26-0367]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CHAIR, ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE relative to the annual report regarding the Bradley Landfill Community Trust Fund No. 48M for Fiscal Year 2024-25.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the City Clerk report dated March 11, 2026 relative to the annual report regarding the Bradley Landfill Community Trust Fund No. 48M for Fiscal Year 2024-25.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the City Clerk. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Receives the annual report on the Bradley Landfill Community Trust Fund for fiscal year 2023-24.
